channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Sundance Episodic Lab 2027: Alfred P. Sloan Grant Track (science and technology series) (closes 3 Dec)
item.description:
Sundance Institute with the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation
Deadline: 3 Dec 2026
Award: USD 17,000 grant plus creative support through the Episodic Lab. Submission fee waived with code EpSloanGrantX121426 on FilmFreeway.

An extended Sloan-only round of the Sundance Episodic Lab for original half-hour or one-hour series whose subject is science, technology or mathematics, or a scientist, engineer or mathematician. Open to a writer or a two-person writing team.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Artists & Mothers Grant 2027: USD 25,000 for a year of childcare (New York City artist-mothers) (closes 4 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Artists & Mothers
Deadline: 4 Jan 2027, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 25,000 to subsidise a year of childcare with the provider of the artist's choice. No application fee stated.

Artists & Mothers gives working artists who identify as mothers USD 25,000 to pay for a year of childcare with a provider of their choice, so they can keep making work at an inflection point in their careers.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: GLEAM 2027: Request for Light-Based Artwork Proposals (Olbrich Botanical Gardens; honorariums USD 5,000 to 30,000) (closes 6 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Olbrich Botanical Gardens (City of Madison Parks Division and Olbrich Botanical Society)
Deadline: 6 Jan 2027, 23:59 CST
Award: All-inclusive honorarium of USD 5,000 to 30,000 per artwork, covering artist fee, materials, fabrication, travel, lodging, install and maintenance. Usually only one USD 30,000 project is selected; proposals under USD 25,000 get the most consideration. Free host lodging and loan projectors and speakers are available. No application fee stated.

GLEAM is an annual night-time light art exhibition across a 16-acre botanical garden and a 10,000 sq ft tropical conservatory.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: NYSCA/Wave Farm Media Arts Assistance Fund (MAAF) for Artists 2027 (closes 15 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Wave Farm (NYSCA regrant)
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027, 23:59 EST
Award: Up to USD 7,500. No application fee.

A NYSCA regrant run by Wave Farm supporting New York State artists to complete or present new sound and moving-image works, including work with emergent technologies.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Awesome Foundation Local Chapters: USD 1,000 Monthly Micro-grants (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NL, Asia) (rolling)
item.description:
Awesome Foundation (local chapters)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Usually USD 1,000 (or local equivalent) per grant, no strings attached, typically one grant per chapter per month. No application fee.

The Awesome Foundation is a network of volunteer giving circles: in each chapter about ten trustees pool their own money to give a USD 1,000 no-strings micro-grant, usually monthly, to a project that adds "awesome" to their area: art, public interventions, community tech, events, science and civic...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IWMF: Fund for Indigenous Journalists and Allies (Reporting on MMIP/MMIWG2T) (rolling)
item.description:
International Women's Media Foundation (IWMF)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Grants average up to USD 5,000; proposals over USD 10,000 considered on a limited basis. Plus editorial and pitching support. No application fee stated.

The IWMF Fund for Indigenous Journalists supports in-depth reporting on Missing and Murdered Indigenous People, Women, Girls and Two-Spirit people (MMIP/MMIWG2T).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mabou Mines SUITE/space Residency 2027-2029 (NYC early-career interdisciplinary performance, two USD 4,000 stipends) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Mabou Mines
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: Two USD 4,000 stipends (dependent on funding), plus 100 hours of rehearsal space and technical support. No application fee.

SUITE/space is Mabou Mines' two-year performance residency for early-career interdisciplinary artists in New York whose practices come from lived experiences at the margins. WHO: NYC-based early-career interdisciplinary performance artists.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Kent Cultural Alliance SFW Residency, Spring 2027 "SERVICE": six-week live-in residency in Chestertown, Maryland (USD 7,500 stipend) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Kent Cultural Alliance
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 17:00 EST
Award: USD 7,500 stipend for the six-week session, travel reimbursed up to USD 1,000, studio and gallery expenses reimbursed up to USD 1,500, and on-site housing with a private en-suite bedroom. No application fee.

A community-engaged residency on Maryland's Eastern Shore. Three artists live and work for six weeks in the Raimond Cultural Center, a restored historic house, around the theme SERVICE, working with local partners For All Seasons, the Kent County Food Pantry and Sumner Hall.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Glen Foerd Artist in Residence 2027: year-long residency for a Philadelphia performance artist or collective (USD 3,000 stipend) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
Glen Foerd
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 3,000 stipend for materials, time and costs, paid in three instalments. USD 10 application fee, waived on request.

Glen Foerd, a riverside historic estate in Philadelphia, selects one Philadelphia-based performance artist or collective for its 2027 residency. Performance is read broadly: music, theatre, film and social practice all count.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Petrides Residency for a Greek Artist in NY (NYFA x ISCP): funded three-month Brooklyn studio residency (USD 9,000 stipend) (closes 8 Dec)
item.description:
New York Foundation for the Arts (NYFA) with sculptor George Petrides and the International Studio & Curatorial Program (ISCP)
Deadline: 8 Dec 2026, 17:00 EST
Award: Fully funded three-month residency with a private studio, a USD 9,000 stipend, a USD 1,000 travel payment and up to USD 300 for professional development. Housing is not arranged by ISCP. No application fee stated.

NYFA, sculptor George Petrides and the International Studio & Curatorial Program (ISCP) offer one Greek artist a fully funded three-month studio residency in Brooklyn.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: University of Notre Dame: Love Ethic Social Innovator Fellowships 2028 (residency plus USD 15,000 and up to USD 50,000 project funding) (closes 11 Dec)
item.description:
University of Notre Dame, Institute for Ethics and the Common Good
Deadline: 11 Dec 2026
Award: Stipend for housing during the residency plus relocation support; USD 15,000 to the fellow's organisation to offset the four-week sabbatical; up to USD 50,000 in subgrant funding after the residency to pilot the proposed project; travel to all programme gatherings covered. No application fee.

Up to six short-term fellowships for practitioners outside academia (nonprofit leaders, community organisers, social workers, faith leaders, entrepreneurs, public-sector professionals) who want time and space to design a new initiative grounded in love-based ethics.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Craigardan Trillium Fellowship 2027 (residency for artists, activists and scholars of color, USD 4,600 + USD 500 honorarium) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Craigardan
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: USD 4,600 fellowship toward a minimum two-week residency (covers the residency fee), plus a USD 500 honorarium. Travel, materials and personal expenses are not covered. USD 25 application fee (waivers available on request).

The Trillium Fellowship supports artists, activists and scholars of color working in any discipline who would benefit from the time and space to pursue their work or find creative retreat at Craigardan, a residency and farm in the Adirondacks.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: SPACES: Echo Artist Residency (Cleveland, paired residency with honorarium and production budget) (closes 10 Feb 2027)
item.description:
SPACES
Deadline: 10 Feb 2027
Award: Artist honorarium and production budget plus lodging in the gallery. SPACES does not publish figures; the Alliance of Artists Communities listing gives a USD 2,000 artist stipend plus USD 500 for travel and materials. No application fee.

Echo is a paired residency at SPACES in Cleveland: each season it selects one Northeast Ohio artist (Cuyahoga and contiguous counties) and one artist from outside the region as a peer cohort, preferring complementary or intersecting themes, though collaboration is not required.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Kala Art Institute: Media Arts Fellowship 2027-28 (Berkeley; USD 3,000 stipend) (closes 1 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Kala Art Institute
Deadline: 1 Mar 2027
Award: USD 3,000 stipend plus facility access.

Kala's long-running Media Arts Fellowship supports four artists working in film and video, sound, animation, performance cinema and media installation. ELIGIBILITY: local, national and international artists not enrolled in a degree programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Folger Institute Artistic Research Fellowships 2027-28 (USD 4,000 to 5,000 per month) (closes 15 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Folger Shakespeare Library (Folger Institute)
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 4,000 per virtual month or USD 5,000 per onsite month.

Artistic research fellowships for artists whose work needs primary research on the early modern world (about 1400 to 1800) and its legacies, using the Folger's collections. ELIGIBILITY: any artist; no degree required and no citizenship rule stated.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Spencer Education Journalism Fellowship 2027-28 (Columbia Journalism School) (closes 4 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Spencer Fellowship at Columbia Journalism School
Deadline: 4 Feb 2027
Award: Residential stipend USD 85,000 or non-residential stipend USD 43,000, plus a USD 7,500 travel and research budget. Non-residential fellows also get airfare and hotel for required NYC trips. No application fee.

The Spencer Education Journalism Fellowship, based at Columbia Journalism School, supports ambitious, research-savvy storytellers producing books, magazine features, documentaries and podcasts that deepen public understanding of critical issues in education.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: COLA-IMAP 2027-29: Independent Master Artist Projects, USD 10,000 (Los Angeles) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: USD 10,000 per artist (budget dependent). No application fee stated.

The City of Los Angeles Independent Master Artist Project (COLA-IMAP) grant supports established LA artists to create new work, presented publicly by the city.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Atlanta Interdisciplinary AI Network (AIAI): Seed Grants 2026 for humanities-forward AI research in Atlanta (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Atlanta Interdisciplinary AI Network (AIAI), Mellon Foundation funded
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: Up to USD 5,000 per project. In line with Mellon policy, no institutional overhead may be charged. Individuals taking the award outside an institution or employer pay income tax on it. No application fee.

AIAI funds humanities-forward AI research and community building that takes place in, or is focused on, the city of Atlanta. 2026 RESEARCH AREAS: Data Centers; AI Civics; AI Literacies; AI and Archives; Small Language Models; Capitalism, Anticapitalism, and Critique.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Van Alen Institute: Re:Paris Prize, USD 35,000 travel research fellowship on design in Africa and its diaspora (US-based applicants) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Van Alen Institute
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026
Award: USD 35,000 travel fellowship; one US-based winner selected through this open call (two Africa-based winners were selected via the 2026 Pan-African Biennale).

The Re:Paris Prize, run by Van Alen Institute, funds research into how design plays a transformative role in Africa and its diaspora. Each winner receives a USD 35,000 travel fellowship for field research that requires international travel to connect with experts and opportunities.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Bernheim Arboretum and Research Forest: Artist in Residence 2027 (Kentucky, USD 2,500 stipend) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Bernheim Arboretum and Research Forest (Arts in Nature programme)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: USD 2,500 stipend, plus a furnished one-bedroom cabin (kitchen, bath, Wi-Fi), a studio near a 32-acre lake, staff support, and free or discounted classes and events. No application fee stated.

Annual residency in which artists live at Bernheim Arboretum and Research Forest and create site-specific work inspired by total immersion in the natural environment. WHO: visual and mixed-media artists, including those working with sound and with performance that incorporates visual elements.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IHS AI and the Workforce Research Grants (up to USD 20,000) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Institute for Humane Studies (IHS)
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: Up to USD 20,000 per award; larger awards possible for exceptional projects. Covers research costs (research assistants, datasets, LLM subscriptions, travel to present), not salary or overhead.

Research grants for academic scholars studying how AI is changing jobs, productivity and economic opportunity. Economics-leaning; IHS is a libertarian-leaning institute. Funds direct research costs only. No country restriction stated. Deadline 15 December 2026 (no time zone given).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Museum of Fine Arts, Houston: Core Residency Program 2027-29 (USD 100,000 over 23 months, artists and critical writers) (closes 8 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Core Residency Program, Glassell School of Art, Museum of Fine Arts, Houston (MFAH)
Deadline: 8 Jan 2027
Award: USD 100,000 (USD 50,000 per year) plus a health and wellness stipend, private studio, and free or discounted Glassell School classes. Application fee USD 12.

Two-year residency for exceptional, highly motivated emerging artists and critical writers committed to developing a sustainable practice.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 February 2027 Cut-Off) (closes 1 Feb 2027)
item.description:
The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF)
Deadline: 1 Feb 2027
Award: Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

The Netherland-America Foundation funds professional artistic and cultural projects that show a clear exchange between Dutch and American artists, institutions or audiences, such as exhibitions, performances and other cultural initiatives that promote dialogue and collaboration.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Vision Maker Media: Creative Shorts Fellowship (up to USD 25,000 for emerging Native filmmakers, rolling)
item.description:
Vision Maker Media
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Up to USD 25,000 production funding, plus USD 5,000 paid separately to the mentor. No application fee shown.

Vision Maker Media's Creative Shorts Fellowship funds emerging Native filmmakers to make a short film of 40 minutes or less (documentary, drama, experimental or animation), with guidelines inviting work that pushes the limits of art and technology.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 November 2026 Cut-Off)
item.description: The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Interactive Media Installations (up to USD 9,000 each)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 9,000 per installation, for up to five installations. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Lytton Plaza Installation Commission (USD 20,000)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · USD 20,000 commission budget. No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council Individual Fellowship 2027 (up to USD 35,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.title: LMCC Manhattan Arts Grants: Creative Engagement 2027
item.description: Lower Manhattan Cultural Council (LMCC) · deadline 12 Nov 2026 · USD 1,000 to 20,000 per grant for public arts events in Manhattan between January and December 2027. No application fee.
